D.treatment: targeted memory reactivation during the nap for one face-name class

O.outcome_detail: name recall after the nap

cells.quote:
To examine the effect of TMR, we first computed the change in the number of names successfully recalled across sleep. This value, Δrecall, did not differ signiﬁcantly between the cued class, designated class C, and the uncued class, designated class U [mean Δrecall 0.75 and 0.21, SDs = 2.03 and 1.70, respectively; t(23) = 0.93, p = 0.36].

As shown in Fig. 2a, the size of the cuing effect on Δrecall was correlated with the duration of stage N3 sleep [χ² (1,N = 24) = 5.18, p = 0.02].
cells.note: The direct cued-versus-uncued recall difference was not significant, but the cueing effect was positively associated with N3 duration.
